method.purpose: Demonstrate how individually ordinary attributes can produce small equivalence classes when composed.
method.generalization: Age is grouped by decade; categorical values otherwise retain the source labels.
method.missing_values: Question-mark source categories are retained as explicit unknown values.
method.limitations: This 1994 census-derived dataset is a reproducible mechanism check, not a claim about current populations or production risk prevalence.

privacy.committed_artifact_contains: Aggregate counts, hashes, provenance, and methodology only.
privacy.committed_artifact_excludes: Every person-level source row and every equivalence-class value.
